status: Staff micro-part BOM fixed for the first image-planning trial; no new images or 3D parts fabricated by this author.

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of ferrule bottom / ground contact
coordinate_frame.X: character horizontal; front view image right is +X
coordinate_frame.handedness: Mira anatomical right is hand-0 / actor −X / fixed FRONT image left. Left hand is hand-1 and empty. Do not mirror source pictures.
coordinate_frame.assembly_anchor: Staff coordinates only. Final world x/z and hand-to-prop transform are not solved by this BOM. Nominal grip axis height 1135 mm is a planning datum, not an implemented pose.

dimension_status: Authored draft registration against the 1701.05 mm existing total staff. Source images are not metrically calibrated. These explicit dimensions allow consistent small-part image requests and later assembly, but are not claimed to have been recovered from generated pixels.
image_requirements: Use the fixed completed-character and hands/staff references together. Every part retains its ID, shared axis and named interface.
Request isolated micro parts, separated front/side/back views at one scale and explicit attachment faces. Keep other costume parts out of each micro part.
S05-A/B need distinct winding; S09–S12 are distinct sides of one cage, not one picture duplicated four times.
Resolve reference contradictions before 3D fabrication. Thin ribs and glass must be visible in the part sheet; do not cover them with the finished body.
Do not add ornaments, hanging loops, a second lamp or extra straps. Internal plain sockets may only complete named joints.
Show BOTH bronze grip-end collars S17/S18 as separate micro parts; S06 is the separate lantern neck socket. All 18 IDs must be accounted for, with S05-A/B counted separately.

parts.name: tapered wooden shaft
parts.short_build_reason: One revolved profile with two radii and closed ends.
parts.source_boundary: Absolute millimetres are authored registration to the old 1701 mm prop, not measurements from the image.

parts.name: foot ferrule sleeve
parts.short_build_reason: One annular extrusion with top and bottom rims.

parts.name: ferrule bottom disc
parts.short_build_reason: One short cylinder; underside is flat.

parts.name: plain leather grip under-sleeve
interfaces: S17 retains lower sleeve end y1030
S18 retains upper sleeve end y1240
parts.short_build_reason: One wrapped cylindrical shell; no hand or cuff included.

parts.name: crossed grip strips A/B
interfaces: strip ends tuck beneath S17/S18 over y1032–1035 and y1235–1238
parts.short_build_reason: Each is one rectangular-section sweep along a helix. Opposite winding makes the visible X pattern.
parts.source_boundary: Where strips cross, the upper strip must lift by its thickness; a crossing is not permission for intersecting visible surfaces. Twist/strip count is construction guidance rather than recovered scan topology.

parts.name: neck collar / shaft socket
parts.source_boundary: S06 is the lantern neck socket. Do not merge it with the separate bronze collar at the upper end of the leather grip, S18.

parts.name: lower lantern cup
interfaces: S16 lower glass pole y1447 inside cup lip up to y1448
parts.short_build_reason: A short bowl-like revolved profile; internal seat is a plain construction surface.
parts.source_boundary: The hidden glass seat is an explicit construction completion, not visible reference evidence.

parts.name: lower cage ring
parts.short_build_reason: One circular ring with a fixed small tube section.

parts.name: left cage rib
parts.short_build_reason: One five-control-point sweep with circular section and closed endpoint caps. Each direction is its own part, not a mirrored reference picture.

parts.name: right cage rib
parts.short_build_reason: One five-control-point sweep with circular section and closed endpoint caps. Each direction is its own part, not a mirrored reference picture.

parts.name: front cage rib
parts.short_build_reason: One five-control-point sweep with circular section and closed endpoint caps. Each direction is its own part, not a mirrored reference picture.

parts.name: back cage rib
parts.short_build_reason: One five-control-point sweep with circular section and closed endpoint caps. Each direction is its own part, not a mirrored reference picture.
parts.source_boundary: The complete and close reference support an oval cage. The occluded back rib and exact cross-section are explicit assembly assumptions, not measured image facts.

parts.name: upper cage ring
parts.short_build_reason: One circular ring matching the lower cage attachment radius.

parts.name: small round finial and stem
parts.source_boundary: Use the round finial in the hands/staff lantern close-up. Do not introduce an unverified hanging loop.

parts.name: warm pale lantern glass/core
interfaces: S07 cup: glass lower pole y1447 seats 1 mm inside cup upper lip y1448
S14 cap: glass upper pole y1665 seats 2 mm inside cap lower y1663
parts.short_build_reason: One ellipsoid. Both poles meet the named cup/cap seats; no extra floating connector.
parts.source_boundary: The generated warm core is a design reference, not evidence of a real light source. Rendering emission or lighting is a separate decision; do not add a second lamp.

parts.name: lower bronze grip-end collar
interfaces: S04 lower sleeve end at y1030
S05-A/B strip end retention; named concealed seating only
parts.short_build_reason: One short annular extrusion with flat annular end faces; no curved cage or wood included.
parts.source_boundary: A separate grip-end collar is visible in the hands/staff GRIP SECTION close-up. It is not S06, the lantern neck socket. Nominal 0.2 mm inner seating into the leather is intentional concealed assembly contact; final geometry must verify the visible boundary.

interfaces: S04 upper sleeve end at y1240
S05-A/B strip end retention; named concealed seating only
parts.short_build_reason: One short annular extrusion with flat annular end faces; no curved cage or wood included.
parts.source_boundary: A separate grip-end collar is visible in the hands/staff GRIP SECTION close-up. It is not S06, the lantern neck socket. Nominal 0.2 mm inner seating into the leather is intentional concealed assembly contact; final geometry must verify the visible boundary.

assembly_checks: All rigid surfaces closed; open material boundaries belong to a deliberately assembled socket, not an accidental crack.
Wood and fittings share one axis; deliberate internal seating overlap must be documented separately from unintended visible surface intersections.
Cage ribs are tangent-compatible with both rings; glass clears all four ribs away from named seats.
Hand-0 contacts the grip sleeve, not the bare shaft/wrist centre; no dynamic pose is implemented here.
Flat ferrule underside meets the actual terrain at the prop x/z in the later runtime test.
Same material batches are preferred; final tri/draw/memory and WebGL appearance remain unmeasured.

revision.change: Added the two visibly separate bronze grip-end collars S17/S18 omitted from the first 16-ID BOM. The previous omission is not called complete. No reference regeneration or runtime change by this author. Strip endpoints extended by 8 mm into the named collar-covered zones; no new part type.
